name: langfuse
description: Sends Claude Code and Codex session traces to Langfuse via a Stop hook — per-turn traces with prompts, generations, tool observations, and backdated timestamps. Includes a SessionStart tripwire that marks programmatically-spawned sessions.

interface.longDescription: Sends per-turn Codex traces, generations, and tool observations to Langfuse after explicit hook review and trust.
defaultPrompt: Help me configure and verify Langfuse tracing.
